interpretation.mg92: Across the four families, public state/action mapping had 3 ambiguous keys among 152 observed keys. Adding the previous public transition reduced this to 1 among 179 keys; adding two preceding actions did not resolve the remaining S3R2 ambiguity.
interpretation.mg91: One ambiguous key among 121 public state/action keys was resolved by adding the previous public transition in this retrospective sample.
interpretation.teacher: Eleven ambiguous public state/action keys reduced to eight with two prior actions; residual aliasing remained.
interpretation.caveat: Key counts grow as history is added, so raw ambiguity counts and fractions are descriptive, not controlled estimates of memory efficiency. The three seeds per family are a small clustered sample. A public observation digest may omit latent inventory/pose or alias different physical states.

decision: A short history/belief representation is a justified hypothesis to test prospectively; this archive does not show that adding memory improves task reward, causal decisions, unfamiliar-family transfer, or solves MG93 failures. No policy changes, no original experiment, no acceptance.
